features.all_source_game_count: count of admitted 2010-2022 completed games for the team
features.all_source_season_count: count of distinct admitted source seasons for the team
features.all_win_share: wins plus one-half ties divided by admitted games
features.all_score_share: aggregate points for divided by aggregate points for plus points against
features.all_win_share_minus_score_share: descriptive result-versus-scoring-share residual; not calibrated luck or causal skill
features.all_close_game_share: games with absolute final margin at most seven divided by admitted games
features.all_close_win_share: wins plus one-half ties among close games; null when no close-game evidence exists
features.all_close_win_share_minus_overall: close-game win share minus all-game win share; null without close-game evidence
features.all_margin_stddev: population standard deviation of team-oriented final margins
features.all_downside_tail_rate: losses by at least seventeen divided by admitted games
features.all_upside_tail_rate: wins by at least seventeen divided by admitted games
features.recent_source_game_count: count of admitted 2020-2022 completed games for the team
features.recent_source_season_count: count of distinct admitted 2020-2022 source seasons for the team
features.recent_close_win_share_minus_overall: 2020-2022 close-game win share minus recent overall win share; null without close games
features.recent_margin_stddev: 2020-2022 population standard deviation of team-oriented final margins
features.pandemic_2020_game_share: 2020 games divided by recent-window games; exposes rather than hides regime composition

feature_contract.structural_zero_policy: ZERO IS VALID ONLY FOR AN OBSERVED COUNT OR RATE WHOSE DENOMINATOR IS POSITIVE

unsupported_fields.turnover_luck: turnover opportunities and recoveries are not present in this outcome-only source
unsupported_fields.causal_clutch_or_coaching_effect: final-score residuals cannot identify causal clutch or coaching effects
unsupported_fields.calibrated_future_regression_probability: this unit materializes descriptive candidates and does not calibrate a future-regression probability

negative_findings: The source is complete at its admitted game grain but 2010 and lower-information team-seasons are sparse; counts and cold starts remain explicit.
The recent window includes the unusual 2020 pandemic season, so pandemic composition is exposed as a separate feature rather than silently normalized away.
Score-share and close-game residuals are descriptive candidate components, not calibrated luck, clutch, coaching, or causal effects.
Turnover, fumble, field-position, injury, and snap evidence is absent and is not inferred from final scores.
The source captures were known in May 2023 rather than at the original historical game times, so these artifacts have development-only retrospective authority.
This unit does not authorize protected evaluation, production promotion, A&M adjustment, BAS, Aggie Excess, or any scientific result.
